item.title: AOC Keeps Her 2028 Options Open
item.description: Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez (D-N.Y.) hinted Sunday she might run for president in 2028 or challenge Sen. Chuck Schumer in a primary.

item.title: Ohio Republicans appear likely to keep Rep. Max Miller
item.description: Rep. Max Miller reportedly missed a key Saturday withdrawal deadline in Ohio's 7th District, effectively ending Republicans' last chance to replace him.

item.title: Six weeks is all you get in the age of rapid information flow
item.description: A significant shift has occurred for everyone. Noticed last week while preparing for an Axios board meeting, starting with a discussion about a six-week timeframe.

item.title: Trump tells Axios: 'We are low keying it' with Iran
item.description: President Trump indicated on Sunday he prefers to continue economic pressure on Iran rather than launch a new military offensive, according to an Axios interview.
